prompt:
THE PLAN. No work has been done yet and the record has no line.

Write the inspection plan. The baseline is already in it. Name the instruments you add at each approval, by the names of the library: "same set", "summary of the change", "undo rehearsal", "release check", "sent as released", "trace of an action". An instrument can be added only at an approval where it can be taken. The baseline costs 100 and the plan, the baseline included, may cost up to 200.

{
  "instruments_added_to_the_baseline": {"A1": [<names; an empty list if none>], "A2": [<names>], "A3": [<names>]},
  "what_the_task_requires_that_no_answer_in_this_plan_will_show": [<one short phrase for each thing>],
  "what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library_or_the_price_did_not_give": "<free text; or 'nothing'>"
}
reply:
```json
{
  "instruments_added_to_the_baseline": {
    "A1": ["summary of the change"],
    "A2": ["summary of the change"],
    "A3": ["trace of an action", "summary of the change"]
  },
  "what_the_task_requires_that_no_answer_in_this_plan_will_show": [
    "That each case's category matches the requester's rule applied to that customer's account (the rule is not given to any instrument, and the category value is not fixed by the agreement)",
    "That the notice wording and the choice of recipients are what the requester intended (the release check only shows that recipients and wording match what was promoted and approved)",
    "That a notice reached the customer (the trace shows only the outbox row, not delivery)",
    "That no call ordered and not confirmed in the sending stage actually wrote a notice, unless the trace says the outbox holds a row for every notice sent and that no earlier-ordered call can still write",
    "That the promotion can still be reversed after the notices are sent (the undo rehearsal covers only the promotion it was taken for, within one hour)"
  ],
  "what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library_or_the_price_did_not_give": "A per-customer check that recomputes each category from the account data using the requester's rule and compares it with the staged and live case rows. No instrument in the library does this, so the category cannot be verified and will be reported as not checked. I also would have wanted a delivery confirmation for each notice; the library offers only the outbox trace. The plan totals 140 (baseline 100, plus 40 for added summaries and 12 for the trace, within the 200 cap). The added summary at A2 checks the live tables after promotion against the A1 picture, and the A3 summary checks for changes after the sending."
}
```

That no call ordered and not confirmed in the sending stage actually wrote a notice, unless the trace says the outbox holds a row for every notice sent and that no earlier-ordered call can still write
That the promotion can still be reversed after the notices are sent (the undo rehearsal covers only the promotion it was taken for, within one hour)
